unitTitle: Ask, answer and follow up at work or school
title: Phrases
subtitle: A2 · Unit 8: Ask, answer and follow up at work or school

steps.title: Phrases
steps.body: First say the document name; then replace it with le, la or les. In your notes, write two versions of a work or study sentence, close the notes, and say the short version without losing which document it refers to.

steps.title: Say the whole block
steps.body: Learn these as blocks, exactly as you hear them. Say each one out loud. Tap the speaker to hear it.

steps.fr: Le compte rendu ? Je le relis avant midi.
steps.en: The report? I am rereading it before noon.
steps.tip: Say it: luh koh(n)t ruh(n)-DÜ zhuh luh ruh-LEEZ ah-vah(n) mee-DEE

steps.fr: La version finale ? Je la corrige aujourd'hui.
steps.en: The final version? I am correcting it today.
steps.tip: Say it: lah vehr-SYOH(N) fee-NAHL zhuh lah koh-REEZH oh-zhoor-DWEE

steps.fr: Les documents ? Nous les classons par date.
steps.en: The documents? We are filing them by date.
steps.tip: Say it: lay doh-kü-MAH(N) noo lay klah-SOH(N) par daht

steps.fr: Le fichier joint ? Je vais le télécharger après le cours.
steps.en: The attached file? I am going to download it after class.
steps.tip: Say it: luh fee-SHYAY zhWA(N) zhuh veh luh day-shahr-ZHAY ah-preh luh koor

steps.fr: La présentation ? Sam va la préparer avec l'équipe.
steps.en: The presentation? Sam is going to prepare it with the team.
steps.tip: Say it: lah pray-zah(n)-tah-SYOH(N) sahm vah lah pray-pah-RAY ah-vehk lay-KEEP

steps.fr: Les corrections ? Je les note dans le brouillon.
steps.en: The corrections? I am writing them down in the draft.
steps.tip: Say it: lay koh-rehk-SYOH(N) zhuh lay noht dah(n) luh broo-YOH(N)

steps.fr: Le document ? Je ne le trouve pas dans le dossier.
steps.en: The document? I cannot find it in the file.
steps.tip: Say it: luh doh-kü-MAH(N) zhuh nuh luh troov pah dah(n) luh doh-SYAY

steps.fr: La note ? Je vais l'envoyer au tuteur.
steps.en: The note? I am going to send it to the supervisor.
steps.tip: Say it: lah noht zhuh veh lah(n)-vwah-YAY oh tü-TUHR
